name: Ammonia and urea
principle: Natural gas or other feed is reformed to hydrogen, nitrogen is added and ammonia is made over iron catalyst in a Haber-Bosch loop; ammonia and CO2 then react in a urea synthesis reactor. Stamicarbon's CO2 stripping process cut steam use from 1,600 to 1,800 kg/t urea in conventional plants to about 800 kg/t, and its N=3 pool-condenser concept runs at 400 t/d in Geleen and 2,100 t/d at Bontang, Indonesia.

gaps.action: Look for an open techno-economic study; record each figure with metric, range, unit, dollar year, basis and source.

notes: Process provenance: the urea train follows the Uhde brochure - carbamate condensation and urea reaction, CO2 stripping, low-pressure recirculation, evaporation, then prilling or fluid-bed granulation, with off-gas scrubbing and desorption/hydrolysis of process condensate. The ammonia synthesis loop itself is not described; the NH3/CO2 tie-in appears only in the block flow.
